name: Postgres view verification
command: cd ~/projects/data-collector && docker rm -f setl-pg >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name setl-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pg -p 55432:5432 postgres:17-alpine >/dev/null && for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec setl-pg pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done && docker cp migrations setl-pg:/m && docker cp sql setl-pg:/s && docker exec setl-pg psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -f /m/001_support_tickets.sql && for f in sql/*.sql; do echo "--- $f"; docker exec setl-pg psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -f "/s/$(basename $f)" || exit 1; done && DATABASE_URL="Host=localhost;Port=55432;Username=postgres;Password=pg;Database=postgres" dotnet test -c Release 2>&1 | tail -6 && docker exec setl-pg psql -U postgres -c "select count(*) from support_tickets" -c "select * from section_f_inputs" -c "select * from section_d_open_tickets"
